pages.title: Welcome to the garden
lines: A quiet corner of the story, made of ink and paper.
Take your time. Nothing here ever hurries you.

pages.title: Getting around
lines: Walk with W A S D or the arrow keys. Hold Shift to jog.
Drag the mouse to look around.
Press E when a prompt appears near something.
When evening comes, your Print grows sleepy and curls up at the rest spot. Press E there to sit beside it.
touchLines: Push the stick to walk. Push it far to jog.
Drag anywhere on the picture to look around.
Tap the big button when a prompt appears near something.
When evening comes, your Print grows sleepy and curls up at the rest spot. Tap the big button there to sit beside it.

pages.title: Looking after your Print
lines: Gather ink puddles by the inkwell and glyph crumbs under the trees. Your pouch holds a few.
Walk up to your Print and hold E to share one. Press Q to change what is in your hand.
Hold R to stroke your Print. That is just for fun.
A fed, happy Print grows. A forgotten one only grows slower, and nothing is ever lost.

pages.title: How a Print grows
lines: Blot: a small, shy splash of ink.
Sprout: it grows a leaf and a little more shape.
Full form: all its parts have come in.
Elder: wise, a little bigger, and wearing a golden halo.
